name: AIR
summary: Drum on nothing. Swing the box like a stick: forward the hi-hat, left the kick, right the snare, back the open hat. Or the four quarters of a break. Sample your own sounds into the pads and loop it.
author: willbearfruits
hardware_note: The strokes are read from the gyro. Which way is forward depends on how the box sits in your hand: FEEL > FORWARD and FEEL > SIDES turn it round.
status_note: Swung on a board on 2026-10-22 (the stroke detector was tuned on it). The breaks, the quantize and the effects came after and have not been on a board yet.
